Class FirestoreImportRecordsSchedulableTest

@IsTest()
private class FirestoreImportRecordsSchedulableTest

Unit tests for the FirestoreImportRecordsSchedulable class. Validates that the schedulable correctly enqueues the Firestore import job and produces the expected transaction log.
